item.title: Rome Elixir by Mast Perfume – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Mast Perfume
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Rome Elixir by Mast Perfume is a warm, spiced aromatic for men from Bharara's Mast Rome line. It is an Eau de Parfum that opens with bergamot, grapefruit and cardamom, turns aromatic with lavender and geranium over cedar, and dries down to a rich base of amber, vanilla, patchouli and vetiver.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Cardamom
Middle: Lavender, Cedarwood, Geranium
Base: Amber, Vanilla, Patchouli, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · For: him

item.description:
Vendor: Mast Perfume
Type:

Overview

Rome My Spirit by Mast Perfume is a fresh aromatic fougere for men, part of Bharara's Mast Rome line. It is an Eau de Parfum that opens on geranium and a soft touch of rose, warms through ginger and sage, and settles into dry cedarwood and vetiver for a clean, polished woody finish.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Geranium, Rose, Fresh Fougere Accord
Middle: Ginger, Sage, Spices
Base: Cedarwood, Vetiver, Woody Accord

Best for

Season: Spring and fall · Wear it: office, everyday · For: him

item.title: Creme of Clouds by Fragrance World – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Fragrance World
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Creme of Clouds by Fragrance World is a soft, creamy gourmand built around coconut milk, vanilla and a caramelised-sugar finish, like whipped cream over crème brûlée. It is an Eau de Parfum, sweet and cosy rather than sharp, and wears as a comforting skin-close cloud of sugar and cream.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Coconut Milk
Middle: Vanilla, Sweet Notes
Base: Caramelized Sugar, Whipped Cream

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and summer · Wear it: everyday, date night · For: him and her

item.title: Boss The Scent by Hugo Boss – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Hugo Boss
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

BOSS The Scent is Hugo Boss's signature seductive fragrance for men, an Eau de Toilette built around ginger, the rare maninka fruit and soft leather. Ginger, mandarin and bergamot give it a warm, spicy-fresh opening, maninka and lavender form a sweet, fruity-aromatic heart, and a smooth leather and woods base keeps it close and inviting. A modern, easy-to-like evening classic.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Ginger, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot
Middle: Maninka, Lavender
Base: Leather, Woody Notes

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, office; evenings

Try It Before You Commit

No two people wear a scent quite the same way. Try a decant over several wears to get to know it before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Dubai Crush by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Bujairami
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Dubai Crush is a warm amber-woody Extrait de Parfum from Bujairami's own line of original creations. Saffron and bergamot open it with a spicy glow, rose and agarwood (oud) form a rich heart, and tonka bean, sugar cane, white musk, amber and oakmoss give it a smooth, softly sweet base. It's a cosy, polished oud-rose for cooler evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Saffron, Bergamot
Middle: Rose, Agarwood (Oud)
Base: Tonka Bean, Sugar Cane, White Musk, Amber, Oakmoss

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions; evenings · Performance: long-lasting

Try It Before You Commit

No two people wear a scent quite the same way. Try a decant over several wears to get to know it before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Mojito Splash by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Bujairami
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Mojito Splash is a bright, minty-herbal citrus scent inspired by Xerjoff Torino21. An Extrait de Parfum, it opens with cool mint, lemon, basil and thyme, settles into a green heart of blackcurrant, lavender, rosemary and jasmine, and dries down to clean musk and vervain. It smells like a fresh mojito on a hot afternoon: crisp, green and easy to wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mint, Lemon, Basil, Thyme
Middle: Blackcurrant, Lavender, Rosemary, Jasmine
Base: Musk, Vervain

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday; daytime · Performance: long-lasting

Try It Before You Commit

No two people wear a scent quite the same way. Try a decant over several wears to get to know it before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Game of Spades Blue Sapphire by Jo Milano – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Jo Milano
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Game of Spades Blue Sapphire is a warm, spicy rose-and-oud scent, often compared to Boadicea the Victorious Blue Sapphire. Lemon, chamomile, sage, saffron and marigold open it bright and herbal with a glow of spice, rose, Indian jasmine and magnolia bloom in the heart, and agarwood, patchouli and amber settle into a deep, smoky-woody drydown. Jo Milano bottles it as a Parfum, the richest strength in the Game of Spades line, and it is a 2026 release.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lemon, Chamomile, Sage, Saffron, Marigold
Middle: Rose, Indian Jasmine, Magnolia
Base: Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Amber

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions; evenings · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

Try It Before You Commit

Every fragrance wears a little differently on skin. A decant lets you wear it several times, in different settings, before you commit to a full bottle.

item.title: Invictus Aqua by Rabanne – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rabanne
Type:
Price: 3.49 - 22.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Invictus Aqua by Rabanne is a bright, salty aquatic for men: sharp grapefruit over a cool sea-water accord, drying down to a smooth amberwood base. This is the current 2024 version of the fragrance, an Eau de Toilette that wears fresh, sporty and easy from morning to evening.

Hand-decanted from the original bottle into a 1ml sample, 2ml, 5ml or 10ml travel spray.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit
Middle: Sea Notes
Base: Amberwood

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday, daytime · Performance: moderate, arm's-length projection

item.title: Date by Fragrance One – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Fragrance One
Type:
Price: 4.49 - 27.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Date is Fragrance One's night-out signature, composed by Alberto Morillas: a juicy burst of mandarin, lemon, bergamot and juniper berry that turns warm and spicy with cardamom and patchouli, then dries down to vetiver and a dark touch of oud. Bright and sweet up top, warm and seductive underneath, it was made for evenings and close encounters. Released in 2019, it is an Extrait de Parfum with strong projection.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Juniper Berry, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Cardamom, Patchouli
Base: Vetiver, Agarwood (Oud)

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:

Overview

Black Tie is Fragrance One's dressed-up evening signature, composed by Alberto Morillas: a burst of juicy orange, Brazilian mandarin and Italian lemon that settles into smoky guaiac wood, earthy patchouli, vetiver and a warm touch of cardamom. Bright up top and dark, dry and elegant underneath, it is an Extrait de Parfum with serious staying power. Released in 2020.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Orange Oil, Brazilian Mandarin, Italian Lemon
Middle: Guaiac Wood
Base: Patchouli, Vetiver, Cardamom

Best for

item.description:

Overview

Office for Men is the debut fragrance from Fragrance One, the niche house founded by Jeremy Fragrance: a clean, polished blend of bright bergamot and radiant ambroxan over soft woods, jasmine and musk. It is built to be the one scent you can wear to work every day, fresh and confident without ever shouting. Released in 2019, it is an Eau de Parfum.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Ambroxan, Bergamot, Orris Root
Middle: Woody Notes, Floral Notes, Amber, Jasmine, Ambergris
Base: Woody Notes, Musk, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday · Time: daytime

Adonis is a warm, sweet Eau de Parfum that opens on lavender, mint and bergamot before settling into Madagascar vanilla, benzoin, amber and tonka bean, often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir. It is a cosy, seductive evening scent made for cooler weather.

Helios is a bright, sun-warmed Eau de Parfum built on creamy coconut, cool mint and juicy green fig, drifting into a salty marine heart over tonka bean and vetiver, often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden. It wears like a day at the beach: fresh, tropical and easy to like.

Mortal is a bold, fruity woody Eau de Parfum for men and women. Bright grapefruit and juicy pineapple burst open over a heart of earthy patchouli, jasmine and cedar. It settles on a mossy, warm base of oakmoss and amber, a confident scent often compared to Creed Aventus.

Mezmar Women is a warm white-floral gourmand Eau de Parfum from Caneza with a quietly magnetic trail. Roasted coffee and sweet almond open into a heart of tuberose and jasmine softened by tonka, drying down to vanilla, sandalwood and cocoa, often compared to Carolina Herrera Good Girl.

Sweet, sensual and confident, it is made for evenings out and date nights in the cooler months.

Uomo is a fresh, fruity-aromatic Eau de Parfum for men. Crisp lemon, bergamot and green apple open with a pinch of nutmeg, before a marine heart of plum, orange blossom and davana. It dries down to a smooth, easygoing base of amber, musk and patchouli that suits everyday wear.

Middle: Marine Notes, Plum, Orange Blossom, Davana

Forest Grove is a green, aromatic-woody unisex Eau de Parfum from Caneza, launched in 2026. Sharp galbanum, ginger and a burst of bitter orange, grapefruit and bergamot open onto a soft heart of matcha, sunny florals and fig, drying down to clean sandalwood, cedarwood, dry amber and musk.

Mezmar Men is a fresh woody-aromatic Eau de Parfum from Caneza with quiet strength and easy charm. Bright bergamot, lavender and cardamom open into a clean orange blossom and geranium heart over a grounded base of patchouli and musk, often compared to Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum.

Buttery caramel and cream open with a hint of liquorice, melting into a honeyed heart of jasmine and tonka before settling on soft vanilla and musk. It is a creamy, dessert-like vanilla often compared to Giardini di Toscana Bianco Latte.

Gardenia, jasmine and a powdery touch of orris build a soft, radiant heart, settling into a smooth base of vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver. It is often compared to Nishane Hundred Silent Ways.

Overview

Elara is a luminous fruity-floral Eau de Parfum from Caneza, opening on juicy lychee, pear and bergamot with a soft, creamy pistachio edge. A rose-and-incense heart gives it a gentle glow before it settles into warm amber, vanilla and musk, often compared to Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif.

Sweet, airy and quietly elegant, it is a polished feminine scent for evenings and special moments that stays bright enough for daytime.

Top: Bergamot, Lychee, Pear, Pistachio

Mezmar Mocha Blend is a coffeehouse gourmand from Caneza's Mezmar line, an Eau de Parfum for men. Bright grapefruit and a thread of olibanum open onto a creamy roasted coffee-and-mocha heart, drying down to sweet vanilla over cedar. It is a warm, sweet coffee scent often compared to Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely.

Middle: Coffee, Mocha, Cream

Type:

Overview

Hero Parfum Intense is the darkest, most concentrated take on Burberry's Hero line: a dry, smoky leather built over a cedarwood core and lit up with cracked black pepper. It reads warm, gritty and grown-up, with a subtle amber sweetness in the dry-down. Released in 2025, it is bottled at Parfum strength, the house's richest concentration (Extrait de Parfum level).

Fragrance Notes

Top: Black Pepper
Middle: Leather
Base: Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting

Overview

Polo Red Parfum is the richest version of Ralph Lauren's Polo Red line: a bright, spicy citrus opening of blood orange, bergamot and pink pepper that settles into an aromatic heart of absinthe, lavender and orris over warm cedar, musk and opoponax. It is a Parfum, the most concentrated Polo Red, hand-decanted from the original bottle into a 1ml sample or a 4ml, 5ml or 10ml travel spray.

Top: Blood Orange, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Absinthe, Lavender, Orris

item.description:
Vendor: Lattafa
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Tharwah Gold is a golden, candied floral from Lattafa's Pride line: a bright lavender-and-bergamot opening melts into orange blossom and jasmine, then dries down to warm vanilla and amber. It is an Eau de Parfum, sweet but polished, often compared to Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense.

The lavender keeps the sweetness lifted, while the vanilla-amber base gives it a cosy, glowing trail that suits cooler evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Bergamot
Middle: Orange Blossom, Egyptian Jasmine
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, special occasions · Time: evening
